answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Every answer that counts. Alternatives: other accepted names, separated by commas. Points: leave empty for the standard points below.

pointsEach.title: Standard points per answer
pointsEach.description: For every answer without its own points.

timeLimit.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeLimit.description: Per player, from the moment they press Start.

spelling.title: Spelling mistakes
spelling.description: Capitals, accents, spaces and hyphens never matter.

showFound.title: Show players which answers count while they play
showFound.description: Off: players only see what they entered, and learn what counted with the results.
